fact_types.title: Total capital-gain distributions reported in box 2a of one logical Form 1099-DIV statement instance furnished by a payer for 2025; the statement instance is peer to evidence and its identity carries no file, upload, scan, document, or evidence key (ADR-0015, instantiated per ADR-0035/ADR-0050). This is the only composable box-2a member under the successor dividend universe. Multiple originals from one payer are distinct statement instances; a corrected copy of the same logical return answers this same fact and supersedes its prior finding.

User-attested closure of the Form 1099-DIV box-2a source family for 2025, keyed on the family membership horizon current at attestation (ADR-0017): true asserts every furnished 1099-DIV box-2a amount is recorded as of that horizon. This claim covers box 2a only - never boxes 1a/1b, residual recorded boxes, boxes 2b/2c/2d, or Form 1040 line 7a completeness (ADR-0016, ADR-0050 decision 2). A later membership transition displaces this closure through horizon succession; re-attestation on the successor horizon is required.

label: Form 1099-DIV box-2a successor member and closure vocabulary for tax year 2025 without residual recorded-boxes (box-12 residual succession)
